name: two-function-example

features.request: Implement clamp(value, low, high) in numbers_demo.py. Return low when value < low, high when value > high, otherwise value. Raise ValueError when low > high. Add unittest coverage for below, within, above, and invalid bounds.
Implement is_even(value) in numbers_demo.py for integers, including zero and negative integers. Return a bool. Add unittest coverage for zero, positive and negative odd/even values.

instructions: Use only the Python standard library. Keep the implementation small. Do not add dependencies or change the existing function's behavior.
